run_bests.note: Fastest WHOLE activity of type Run whose distance is at least min_km, ranked by average moving pace (moving time / distance). These are whole-activity paces, not Strava best efforts or segment times. Duplicates are excluded, and so are runs faster than min_plausible_pace_s (GPS glitches, uncalibrated treadmills).

meta.km_note: Swim distances are in km too (Strava metres / 1000).
meta.type_All: Rows with type 'All' are the sum over every type for that period.
